aggregation.random_family: compute each permutation estimate, average 100 permutations within model-seed and site-density
aggregation.model_seed: average five accepted model seeds within site-density
aggregation.density: average four density-specific effects within site for the overall primary contrast
aggregation.site: unweighted mean of 18 paired site effects

primary_estimand: intervened minus unaltered held-out balanced accuracy in percentage points

uncertainty.test: exact two-sided paired sign-flip test over all 2^18 site sign assignments
uncertainty.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the four named primary contrasts

secondary_status: descriptive with paired site-bootstrap intervals; no confirmatory p-values
representation_prediction_analysis: descriptive Spearman association across 72 site-density cells; no mediation or causal interpretation
decision_rules: A negative intervention effect indicates that the intact component supported held-out prediction under this trained model and pipeline.
Map sensitivity establishes computational use of learned maps, not biological bundle geometry.
Topology sensitivity establishes reliance on the constructed graph, not anatomy or causal flow.
Representation and prediction changes may be described as co-occurring, not as causal mediation.
Insensitivity to an intervention is reported as no detected functional dependence, not proof of absence.
The frozen Study 1 conclusion cannot be overwritten by this post-hoc extension.

unblinding.required_acknowledgement: I acknowledge that this command opens the audited E1 scientific values under analysis protocol v1.
unblinding.terminal_policy: do not print scientific values; write, hash, and audit the complete artifact before interpretation
